chunks: By the beneficence of your Lord. This will be the great success.
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'great success' in the context of divine beneficence?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse from Surah Ad-Dukhan is often linked to the concept of divine grace (fadl) that culminates in the ultimate success of the faithful, particularly emphasizing the role of the Ahl al-Bayt as the recipients and guides of this bounty. The 'great success' is interpreted not merely as individual salvation but as the attainment of proximity to God through adherence to divine guidance and the Imams. This highlights the Shia view that true victory is rooted in recognizing and following the divinely appointed leadership.
